blender: 5.2.1 LTS, scene built through Blender MCP, frames rendered headless from the saved .blend with EEVEE
artwork: The supplied wordmark SVG flattened to contours (extract-oxhack-logo.py). Triangle: 0.60-opacity glass panel, 0.12 deep frame, raised traces and labels. Letters: outline ring and white face extruded to the same 0.14 depth, the face 0.003 proud. Colour from the SVG's own shape, panel, text and year gradients; emission carries most of each colour so it holds on the light LCD, and side walls are darker by object-space normal. The navy glow is the source's blurred Shadow and g9 groups rasterized to scripts/blender/oxhack-wordmark-glow.png by oxhack-wordmark-tools.mjs, on a plane behind the letters at .28 strength, because the user found the full glow too heavy on the LCD.

delivery.color: RGB555-style color and 5-bit soft alpha (values under 8 become 0); transparent background; nearest-neighbour display
delivery.playback: Intro frames 1-120 once per selection, then frames 121-216 loop as an idle sway; frame 120 immediately for reduced motion. Frame 216 is pixel-identical to frame 120, and poster.png is that frame.
delivery.motion: Triangle alone at the frame centre spins five turns around a tilted near-vertical axis, from 69 deg/frame (5.8 rev/s) with friction decay and EEVEE motion blur until frame 48, gliding from frame 26 to land tip-right on frame 52 with a damped overshoot. A charge runs the traces and heats the tip. K C A leave the tip from frame 60 and run straight into their slots; H x O follow, hop up over the row in front of the glass and drop in; launches are 5 frames apart, each letter flips, overshoots and springs back, and each launch recoils the triangle. 2 and 6 pop on frames 100 and 104. A faint navy glow fades up over frames 105-118. The compact logo's power-on finale then plays frame for frame, counted from frame 100: twin pulses run the frame's edges over frames 101-109, charge runs the traces over 106-112, a wide sheen crosses over 108-118, and the pads flash and throw four-point stars over 110-118. Then the whole logo sways (yaw 0.13 rad, pitch 0.04 rad, 0.022 bob) over a seamless 96-frame loop.
